colors.name: Colours
colors.info: Each section picks one of these schemes. Keep text and button labels at a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against their background (WCAG 2.1 AA).
colors.heading: Headings

motion.name: Motion
motion.motion: Animate sections as they scroll into view
motion.info: Visitors whose device asks for reduced motion never see these animations.

social.name: Social sharing
social.info: Used when a page has no image of its own. 1200 x 628 px works best.

contact_form.name: Contact form
contact_form.heading: Heading
contact_form.trade_fields_info: Replaces name and phone with business name, country and expected volume, for wholesale inquiries. Submissions arrive at the store's sender email.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.heading: Heading
faq.use_product_faq_info: On product pages, shows the product's FAQ metafield (custom.faq) in place of the questions below, and nothing when the product has none. Other pages always show the questions below.

reviews.name: Reviews
reviews.info: Add the block from your reviews app. Nothing shows until you do.

video.name: Video
video.heading: Heading
video.video_url_info: Used when no Shopify-hosted video is chosen.
video.cover_image_info: Shown over a YouTube or Vimeo video until it is played.

certification.name: Certification
certification.title: Name
certification.link_info: For example the certificate or the certifier's register entry.

origin_map.name: Origin map
origin_map.heading: Heading
origin_map.map_info: Write the pinned place into the image's alt text. Screen readers do not read the pin or its label.
origin_map.caption: Caption
origin_map.caption_info: For example the map's source and licence.

hero.name: Hero
hero.video_info: Plays muted on a loop in place of the image, with a pause button. Visitors who ask for reduced motion see it paused.
hero.heading: Heading
hero.heading_info: The first section on a page shows this as the page's main heading.

header.name: Header
header.show_shop_name: Show store name next to the logo

nutrition.name: Nutrition
nutrition.info: Shows the product's nutrition metafield (custom.nutrition) as a table. Shows nothing when it is empty.
nutrition.heading: Heading

pack_details.name: Pack details
pack_details.info: Shows shelf life (custom.shelf_life_months) and, for the selected variant, closure, gross weight and carton (custom.closure, custom.gross_weight_kg, custom.carton). Shows nothing when all are empty.
pack_details.heading: Heading

how_to_use.name: How to use
how_to_use.info: Shows the product's how to use metafield (custom.how_to_use), one step per entry. Shows nothing when it is empty.
how_to_use.heading: Heading
